property_summary: For any external depositor and any deposit amount sent to C's fallback, a subsequent withdrawAll by the owner must transfer the entire contract balance to the owner, leaving address(c).balance == 0 and increasing the owner's balance by that amount; the mutant deletes the withdraw call so funds remain stuck in C.
change_summary: Delete the call to withdraw(address(this).balance) so withdrawAll no longer transfers any funds.
